claims: The Czech Republic is also known as Czechia.
Czechia is a landlocked Central European nation.
Czechia has a population of ~10.8 million.
Czechia is a parliamentary democracy.
Prague is the capital of Czechia.
Prague is the largest city in Czechia.
The official language of Czechia is Czech.
The currency of Czechia is the Czech Crown (CZK).
Major cities in Czechia include Brno, Ostrava, Plzeň (Pilsen), and Liberec.
Czechia is a parliamentary republic.
Czechia has a president as head of state.
Czechia has a prime minister as head of government.
Czechia is located in Central Europe.
Czechia is bordered by Germany, Austria, Slovakia, and Poland.
Czechia was formed as an independent state in 1993.
Czechia was formed following the peaceful dissolution of Czechoslovakia.
The Czech Republic is a member of the EU.
The Czech Republic is a member of the Schengen Area.
US citizens can enter the Czech Republic for tourism without a visa for up to 90 days.
UK citizens can enter the Czech Republic for tourism without a visa for up to 90 days.
Canada citizens can enter the Czech Republic for tourism without a visa for up to 90 days.
Czechia is in the EU but does not use the Euro.
Pilsner-style lager was invented in Czechia.
Franz Kafka is a famous person associated with Czechia.
Antonín Dvořák is a famous person associated with Czechia.
Václav Havel is a famous person associated with Czechia.
